verdict.rationale: Connecting to cloud AI providers is a fair question for a local-LLM desktop app, but every item in the pack describes local models only: downloading and running them, serving them on OpenAI-like endpoints, and using MCP servers with them. The one possible hint is that Bionic can run 'frontier open models' like GLM and Kimi for demanding tasks, but it never says these are cloud-hosted or come from a cloud provider. There is no evidence of connecting to cloud AI providers within the same interface.
